The '''Swellen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the system was the location of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Repair Yard]] [[KDY-77 repair yard|KDY-77]] which serviced the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]'' when it was captured by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] strike team during the [[Battle of Swellen]].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />
